name: Vital Smash (Combat)
body:
Your decisive strike can put an opponent off balance.

Prerequisite(s): Vital Strike

Benefit(s): When you deal damage to a creature while using the Vital Strike feat, you may designate one ally within 30 feet. In regards to the chosen ally, that creature is flat-footed until your next turn.
